lines.text: CONMED ’s 2.9mm Arthroscope offers superior optical performance in a smaller
package than a standard 4mm arthroscope. Features include:
» Equivalent light transmission and image size to a 4mm arthroscope
» Increased depth-of-field and less distortion compared to competitive 4mm arthroscopes
» Increased durability with new proprietary sheath system
A proprietary scope-sheath interface offers better protection of the arthroscope and
» Smaller outside diameter allows for better maneuverability
» Scope-sheath interface ensures excellent tip protection
